data.title: Hwail Pharmaceutical Raises KRW 10 Billion via Private Convertible Bond Issue
data.description:
Hwail Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. ( (KR:061250) ) has issued an announcement.

Hwail Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. has approved the issuance of KRW 10 billion in unsecured private placement convertible bonds maturing on October 8, 2029, with a 2% annual coupon and a 4% yield to maturity. The funds raised will be used entirely for operating capital, signaling a move to bolster liquidity and support ongoing business activities without immediate equity dilution.

The bonds carry a conversion price of KRW 8,294 per share, implying potential issuance of about 1.21 million new common shares, or 14.32% of current shares, if fully converted. Embedded put and call options give investors early redemption rights and the issuer flexibility to reallocate holdings, while Korea Bond Investment Management and Korea Investment & Securities are designated investors, highlighting targeted institutional backing for Hwail’s financing plan.

By boosting capacity on existing fiber infrastructure while lowering power consumption and space requirements, the deployment enhances Telxius’ network efficiency and cost profile, reinforcing its positioning in high-capacity international connectivity and creating a more resilient foundation for seamless links between terrestrial and subsea networks.
